method: A separate read-only, network-disabled, non-root Docker container computed sha256sum /usr/src/php.tar.xz, printed PHP_SHA256, PHP_VERSION and PHP_INT_SIZE. Docker image inspect reported the image ID, architecture and OS; docker inspect after completion reported no such container.
limitations: The image contains the locked source archive, but this does not prove its binary was built from that archive.
This is supplementary reference evidence, not Phego execution or work-package acceptance.
Container runtime isolation, exit code and empty stderr are recorded observations; this log alone cannot independently reconstruct all launch conditions or interruption cleanup.
